places.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
places.ai_summary: An iconic observation deck offering panoramic views of Singapore’s skyline, Marina Bay, and the surrounding landmarks.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during sunset for stunning views.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the breathtaking views.

places.name: Gardens by the Bay
places.ai_summary: A futuristic garden featuring the iconic Supertree Grove, Cloud Forest, and Flower Dome, showcasing nature and technology.

opening_hours.notes: Individual attractions may have different timings.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the evening light show at the Supertree Grove.

attribution.title: Supertree Grove, Gardens by the Bay, Singapore - 20120712-02
attribution.author: Shiny Things.
attribution.description: The "supertrees" tower over Gardens by the Bay, Singapore. The tallest one even has a restaurant in it. An elevated walkway spans around the trees for visitors.

places.name: Merlion Park
places.ai_summary: A famous Singapore landmark with a statue of a merlion, symbolizing Singapore’s origin as a fishing village.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Take a boat ride for a different view of the Merlion.

attribution.title: Singapore Merlion BCT
attribution.author: Bjørn Christian Tørrissen
attribution.description: A statue in Merlion Park near the Central Business District in downtown Singapore. The merlion is a fictional creature that is half lion and half mermaid (the fishy part, obviously). The big merlion has a small "cub" that can be seen in the background to the right of the big statue in this photo.

places.name: Sentosa Island
places.ai_summary: A popular resort destination with attractions like Universal Studios, S.E.A. Aquarium, and Adventure Cove Waterpark.

opening_hours.notes: Check individual attractions for specific timings.

places.place_tip: Consider a multi-attraction pass for savings.

places.name: Universal Studios Singapore
places.ai_summary: A world-class theme park with rides and shows based on popular movies and TV shows.

opening_hours.notes: Check the website for the latest operating hours.

places.place_tip: Download the park map and plan your route in advance.

places.name: Singapore Flyer
places.ai_summary: A giant Ferris wheel offering breathtaking views of the Singapore skyline and beyond.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Book a flight during sunset for a magical experience.

attribution.title: Singapore Flyer 20250903
attribution.author: DvTor8303
attribution.usage_terms: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication
attribution.description: Photo of Singapore Flyer taken from Marina Bay Overpass on 03.09.2025

places.name: Clarke Quay
places.ai_summary: A historical riverside quay with vibrant nightlife, dining, and entertainment options.

opening_hours.notes: Check individual venues for specific timings.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a river cruise for a different perspective of Clarke Quay.

places.name: Chinatown Heritage Centre
places.ai_summary: A cultural museum showcasing the history and heritage of Singapore’s Chinese community.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for a more in-depth experience.

places.name: Little India (Serangoon Road)
places.ai_summary: A vibrant district known for its Indian heritage, with colorful shops, restaurants, and the famous Mustafa Centre.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot to take in the sights and sounds.

places.place_tip: Try the local Indian cuisine at a hawker centre.

places.name: Orchard Road Shopping Belt
places.ai_summary: Singapore’s famous shopping street, lined with malls, boutiques, and restaurants.

opening_hours.notes: Check individual stores for specific timings.

places.place_tip: Visit during the Great Singapore Sale for amazing discounts.

attribution.title: Presenting... the real ION (8200217734)
attribution.author: Erwin Soo from Singapore, Singapore
attribution.description: ION Orchard Shopping Mall at Orchard Road, Singapore

places.name: Botanic Gardens (UNESCO World Heritage Site)
places.ai_summary: A lush tropical garden and UNESCO World Heritage site, home to a vast collection of plants and flowers.

opening_hours.notes: The National Orchid Garden requires an entry fee.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the National Orchid Garden inside the Botanic Gardens.

places.name: National Gallery Singapore
places.ai_summary: An art museum located in the heart of the city, showcasing Singaporean and Southeast Asian art.

opening_hours.notes: Free admission for Singaporeans and Permanent Residents.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for a more enriching experience.

attribution.title: Interior of the National Gallery Singapore
attribution.author: Basile Morin
attribution.description: Interior of the National Gallery of Singapore with the airy corridors on 4 levels, the staircases and escalators, in the evening. Architect : Jean-Francois Milou

places.name: ArtScience Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum at Marina Bay Sands featuring exhibitions at the intersection of art, science, and technology.

opening_hours.notes: Check the website for current exhibitions and timings.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with Marina Bay Sands SkyPark for a full day of exploration.

attribution.title: ArtScience Museum, Marina Bay Sands, Singapore
attribution.author: Basile Morin
attribution.description: ArtScience Museum, Marina Bay Sands, in the late afternoon, in front of the skyline of the Central Business District, Singapore. Architect : Moshe Safdie.

places.name: Esplanade – Theatres on the Bay
places.ai_summary: A performing arts center with a distinctive durian-shaped design, hosting concerts, theatre performances, and more.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for performance timings.

places.place_tip: Catch a free performance at the Esplanade Outdoor Theatre if you can.

attribution.title: The Esplanade – Theatres on the Bay
attribution.author: William Cho
attribution.description: The Esplanade – Theatres on the Bay, Singapore

places.name: Jurong Bird Park
places.ai_summary: A renowned bird park with a large collection of birds, offering interactive exhibits and shows.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission at 5:30 PM.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes as the park is quite large.

attribution.title: Jurong Bird Park 2014
attribution.author: aamanatullah
attribution.description: A sign at Jurong Bird Park in 2014

places.name: Singapore Zoo
places.ai_summary: A world-renowned zoo known for its innovative 'open' enclosures and a wide variety of animals.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission at 5:30 PM.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the animal feeding sessions for a more interactive experience.

places.name: Night Safari
places.ai_summary: The world’s first nocturnal zoo, offering a unique safari experience after dark.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission at 11:15 PM.

places.place_tip: Take the tram ride for a comprehensive tour of the safari.

attribution.title: Entrance of Night Safari, Singapore, 2012
attribution.author: Allie Caulfield
attribution.description: Entrance of Night Safari, Singapore in 2012.

places.name: River Wonders
places.ai_summary: A river-themed park showcasing animals and plants from various river ecosystems around the world.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission at 5:30 PM.

places.place_tip: Visit the Amazon Flooded Forest exhibit for a unique experience.

attribution.title: Entrance of River Safari, Singapore
attribution.author: aamanatullah
attribution.description: Entrance of the River Safari in Singapore.

places.name: Haw Par Villa
places.ai_summary: A theme park showcasing Chinese mythology and folklore through dioramas and sculptures.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission at 6:00 PM.

places.place_tip: Explore the park with an open mind and enjoy the quirky sculptures.

attribution.title: A walk in Haw Par Villa Singapore (2025) - img 15
attribution.author: Chainwit.
attribution.description: A walk in Haw Par Villa Singapore

places.name: East Coast Park
places.ai_summary: A popular beach park with recreational facilities, dining, and a scenic coastline.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Try the local seafood at a beachside restaurant.
